description: Foundation: dependencies, config, database, ORM models, Alembic migrations, and core error helpers. This FEAT has no dependencies on other FEATs and must be completed first — every other FEAT builds on the DB session, models, and config it creates.
steps: Update backend/requirements.txt to add exact pinned versions: sqlalchemy==2.0.30, aiosqlite==0.20.0, alembic==1.13.1, pytest-asyncio==0.23.7, bcrypt==4.1.3, python-multipart==0.0.9. Keep all existing pinned versions unchanged.

Create backend/app/core/config.py: use pydantic_settings or plain os.getenv to expose Settings dataclass with fields: DATABASE_URL (default 'sqlite+aiosqlite:///./medihistory.db'), JWT_SECRET_KEY (no default — must be set), UPLOAD_DIR (default './uploads'), MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (default 10*1024*1024), ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS (default 1800), REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_DAYS (default 30), ENABLE_INTERACTION_CHECK (default False). Expose a get_settings() function cached with functools.lru_cache.

Create backend/app/core/database.py: create async SQLAlchemy engine from settings.DATABASE_URL, create AsyncSessionLocal sessionmaker, define Base = declarative_base(), and define async get_db() dependency that yields AsyncSession. Include a create_all_tables() coroutine for test use (not for production — Alembic handles prod).

Create backend/app/core/errors.py: define ErrorDetail(code, message, details) and ErrorResponse(error: ErrorDetail) Pydantic models. Define raise_http_error(status_code, code, message, details={}) that raises HTTPException with detail as a dict matching the error shape. This is the single place all routers raise errors from.
Create backend/app/models/__init__.py importing all model classes so Alembic can discover them.

Create backend/app/models/patient.py: Patient model with columns id (String(36) PK, default uuid4), email (String(254) unique not null), password_hash (String(256) not null), display_name (String(100) not null), created_at (DateTime UTC default), updated_at (DateTime UTC default+onupdate). Add __tablename__ = 'patients'. Index on email.

Create backend/app/models/doctor.py: Doctor model with columns id (String(36) PK), patient_id (String(36) FK→patients.id not null), name (String(200) not null), specialty (String(100) nullable), specialty_custom (String(200) nullable), clinic_name (String(200) nullable), contact_notes (Text nullable), is_deleted (Boolean default False), created_at, updated_at. Index on (patient_id, is_deleted).

Create backend/app/models/prescription.py: Prescription model with columns id (String(36) PK), patient_id (String(36) FK→patients.id not null), doctor_id (String(36) FK→doctors.id nullable, SET NULL on delete), prescription_date (Date nullable), ocr_status (String(20) not null default 'PENDING'), source_document_path (String(512) nullable), patient_notes (Text nullable), created_at, updated_at. Relationship to medicines (cascade='all, delete-orphan'). Index on (patient_id, ocr_status).

Create backend/app/models/medicine.py: PrescriptionMedicine model with columns id (String(36) PK), prescription_id (String(36) FK→prescriptions.id not null CASCADE DELETE), patient_id (String(36) FK→patients.id not null), brand_name (String(200) nullable), active_ingredient (String(200) nullable), active_ingredient_slug (String(200) nullable — lowercased+slugified for grouping), strength (String(100) nullable), formulation (String(100) nullable), dosage (Text nullable), frequency (String(100) nullable), route (String(100) nullable), duration (String(100) nullable), review_state (String(20) not null default 'PENDING_REVIEW'), medicine_status (String(20) not null default 'UNKNOWN'), confidence_score (Float nullable), raw_value (Text nullable), source_reference (String(512) nullable), created_at, updated_at. Index on (patient_id, active_ingredient_slug, medicine_status).

Create backend/app/models/duplicate_alert.py: DuplicateAlert model with columns id (String(36) PK), patient_id (String(36) FK→patients.id not null), medicine_a_id (String(36) FK→prescription_medicines.id nullable SET NULL), medicine_b_id (String(36) FK→prescription_medicines.id nullable SET NULL), matched_active_ingredient (String(200) nullable), match_type (String(20) not null), match_confidence (Float not null default 0.0), formulation_notes (Text nullable), reviewed_by_patient (Boolean default False), reviewed_at (DateTime nullable), created_at, updated_at. Index on (patient_id, reviewed_by_patient).

Create backend/app/models/history.py: MedicalHistorySummary model with columns id (String(36) PK), patient_id (String(36) FK→patients.id not null), version_number (Integer not null), is_current (Boolean default False), status (String(20) not null default 'GENERATING'), summary_json (Text nullable — stores serialised SummaryContent), medicine_count (Integer default 0), prescription_count (Integer default 0), job_id (String(36) nullable), generated_at (DateTime nullable), created_at. Index on (patient_id, is_current).

Create backend/app/models/reminder.py: Reminder model with columns id (String(36) PK), patient_id (String(36) FK→patients.id not null), prescription_medicine_id (String(36) FK→prescription_medicines.id nullable SET NULL), reminder_times (Text not null — JSON-encoded list of 'HH:MM' strings), frequency_display (String(100) nullable), is_active (Boolean default True), created_at, updated_at. Index on (patient_id, is_active).

Create backend/app/models/refresh_token.py: RefreshToken model with columns id (String(36) PK), patient_id (String(36) FK→patients.id not null), token_hash (String(256) not null unique), expires_at (DateTime not null), revoked (Boolean default False), created_at. Index on (patient_id, revoked). Rationale for DB-stored refresh tokens: allows explicit invalidation on logout without requiring a token blacklist; the extra DB round-trip on refresh is acceptable for a health app where refresh happens infrequently.

Set up Alembic: create backend/migrations/ directory, run 'alembic init migrations' in backend/, then edit backend/migrations/alembic.ini to set sqlalchemy.url = placeholder (will be overridden in env.py), and edit backend/migrations/env.py to: import app.models (to register all models with Base), read DATABASE_URL from os.environ with default, configure async engine using run_async_migrations() pattern for asyncio migration runs. The env.py must support both 'alembic upgrade head' (offline/sync for SQLite) and the async engine.

Generate initial migration: set DATABASE_URL env var, run 'alembic revision --autogenerate -m "initial schema"' from backend/ to produce backend/migrations/versions/xxxx_initial_schema.py. Review the generated file and ensure all 8 tables (patients, doctors, prescriptions, prescription_medicines, duplicate_alerts, medical_history_summaries, reminders, refresh_tokens) are present with correct columns and indexes.
Commit: chore: add SQLAlchemy models, Alembic migrations, config and error helpers
acceptance_criteria: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt succeeds with all new packages at pinned versions
python -c 'from app.core.config import get_settings; print(get_settings().DATABASE_URL)' prints the default URL
python -c 'from app.models import patient, doctor, prescription, medicine, duplicate_alert, history, reminder, refresh_token' raises no import errors
JWT_SECRET_KEY=synthetic-test-secret DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///./test.db alembic -c migrations/alembic.ini upgrade head runs without error
All 8 tables exist in the migrated database
verification: $env:JWT_SECRET_KEY='synthetic-test-secret'; $env:DATABASE_URL='sqlite+aiosqlite:///./test.db'; cd backend && python -m alembic -c migrations/alembic.ini upgrade head
findings: Python is available as 'py' (not 'python') on this Windows machine. All commands must use 'py' instead of 'python'. Alembic was initialized with 'alembic init migrations' which places alembic.ini in backend/ by default; the FEAT-001 verification commands reference backend/migrations/alembic.ini so a second copy was created there. The original backend/alembic.ini can be used with 'py -m alembic upgrade head' from backend/ directly, or use 'py -m alembic -c migrations/alembic.ini upgrade head' for the migrations/ copy. Both work. All 8 tables (patients, doctors, prescriptions, prescription_medicines, duplicate_alerts, medical_history_summaries, reminders, refresh_tokens) confirmed present after 'upgrade head'. All 11 existing tests pass. pydantic-settings==2.3.4 was added to requirements.txt (needed for future FEATs that use BaseSettings). The get_db() async dependency in database.py commits on success and rolls back on exception. render_as_batch=True is set in env.py for SQLite ALTER TABLE compatibility in future migrations.
